cell_model: Panasonic NCR18650B (3.25 Ah, 1.625 A [0.5C] Std, 0.8125 A [0.25C] JEITA < 10°C, 45.0°C Ceiling)
overall_release_verdict: RELEASE BLOCKED — 3 CRITICAL ASIL-D / JEITA / IEC 62660-2 REGRESSIONS

scenario.name: Standard 25°C Nominal CC-CV Charge
scenario.description: Standard 0.5C (1.625 A) constant-current / constant-voltage charge at 25.0°C room temperature.

scenario.name: 5°C Cold-Weather JEITA Derating Charge
scenario.description: Critical cold-soak charge at 5.0°C. JEITA mandates derating from 1.625 A (0.5C) to 0.8125 A (0.25C) below 10.0°C to prevent metallic lithium plating on the graphite anode.

violations.message: Candidate v2.4.1 commanded 1.625 A (0.5C) at 5.0°C, exceeding JEITA 0.8125 A (0.25C) limit by +100%.
violations.asm_root_cause: REA-BIN-DIFF-01: Removed < 10.0°C (0x41200000) derating branch in bms_step.

scenario.name: 8°C Cool-Ambient Commuter Top-Up
scenario.description: 8.0°C sub-10°C boundary verification test ensuring 0.25C (0.8125 A) JEITA clamp remains active until core cell temperature crosses 10.0°C.

violations.message: Candidate v2.4.1 commanded 1.625 A (0.5C) at 8.0°C, exceeding JEITA 0.8125 A (0.25C) limit by +100%.
violations.asm_root_cause: REA-BIN-DIFF-01: Removed < 10.0°C (0x41200000) derating branch in bms_step.

scenario.name: -4°C Sub-Freezing Charge Inhibit
scenario.description: Sub-zero (-4.0°C) charge attempt. Both v1 and v2 must inhibit charging (0.0 A) and open contactors below 0.0°C.

scenario.name: 47°C High-Temperature Thermal Cutoff Abuse
scenario.description: High-temperature desert soak at 46.2°C–47.5°C. Baseline v1 trips hard thermal cutoff at 45.0°C (0.0 A), whereas Candidate v2.4.1 raises cutoff to 50.0°C and charges to 99.7% SoC at 47°C.

violations.message: Candidate v2.4.1 continued charging at 48.57°C up to 99.7% SoC (Baseline v1 opened contactor at 45.0°C -> 0.0 A).

scenario.name: 44°C Pre-Threshold Thermal Ramp
scenario.description: Starts at 43.8°C and self-heats via I^2*R Joule heating across the 45.0°C safety boundary during charging.

violations.message: Candidate v2.4.1 continued charging at 46.25°C up to 94.1% SoC (Baseline v1 opened contactor at 45.0°C -> 0.0 A).

scenario.name: 4.26V Over-Voltage Transducer Surge
scenario.description: Injects 4.26V terminal over-voltage condition above the 4.25V hard fault ceiling to verify immediate contactor opening.

scenario.name: NTC Thermistor Open-Circuit Fault (Fast-Charge SoC 35%)
scenario.description: Injects temp_sensor_fail = 1 at t = 300s while in fast-charge regime (35% SoC). Baseline v1 opens contactor in 1 tick; Candidate v2 bypasses fault check below 80% SoC.

violations.message: Candidate v2.4.1 failed to open contactor when temp_sensor_fail=1 injected at t=300s (continued driving 1.625 A).
violations.asm_root_cause: REA-BIN-DIFF-03: Fault check gated by `soc >= 0.80` (`comisd` branch in bms_step).

scenario.name: NTC Thermistor Fault at High SoC (85% SoC)
scenario.description: Injects temp_sensor_fail = 1 at t = 180s when SoC >= 80%. Both v1 and v2 trip, masking v2's conditional bypass in high-SoC-only fault tests.

scenario.name: 35°C Warm Highway Fast Top-Up (40% to 90% SoC)
scenario.description: Warm ambient 35.0°C charging profile remaining below the 45.0°C thermal limit.
